msg: Reading customer drawing drawing.pdf with Claude Opus 5.5
NIST FTC-10: NOT SPECIFIED - confirm with customer, mm, ±0.75 mm general tolerance, 25 machining notes, 8 questions for the customer
notes: Drawing note 1/2: the CAD model is required for product definition. Only directly toleranced and basic dimensions appear on the drawing; all other geometry (overall size, pocket size and location, hole positions, depths) must come from the model. The model was not supplied, so only the face op is listed. The profile, pocket and hole features cannot be dimensioned without guessing.
Standards: ASME Y14.5M-1994 dimensioning and tolerancing; ASME Y14.41-2003 for dataset and datum targets. Units are mm.
General: profile of a surface 1.5 to A|B|C applies to all untoleranced surfaces (about ±0.75 equivalent).
Datum A: top face, flatness 0.2.
Datum B: Ø6 ±0.15 hole, perpendicularity Ø0.25 to A.
Datum C: Ø6 ±0.15 hole, position Ø0.5 to A|B.
2X Ø6 ±0.15 holes: position Ø0.65 to A|B|C.
Top pocket: profile 1.2 to A|B|C on all surfaces inside the pocket.

8X Ø2.5 ±0.15 holes in the pocket floor: position Ø0.75 to A|B|C. Per note 4, the full diameter of each hole must intersect the cross-drilled hole at its bottom and must not contact the far side of the cross-drilled hole.
4X Ø7 ±0.25 cross-drilled holes in the side: position Ø0 at MMC to A|B|C, cylindricity 0.1.
4X counterbores Ø10 ±0.25 x 10 ±0.2 deep on side faces F65 and F81: position Ø0.8 to A|B|C at the surface and Ø1.2 to A|B|C at the bottom of the counterbores.
4X counterbores Ø10 ±0.25 x 2 ±0.15 deep at the flange holes: position Ø1 at MMC to A|B|C.
Datum D: 3 coplanar surfaces, profile 1.2 to A|B|C and 0.2 to A.
Ø3.5 G6 holes (datums E, F, G): position Ø0.8 to D|B|C (note 4) and perpendicularity Ø0.12 to D.
3 sets of 2X M3x0.5-6g threads: position Ø0.8 with a 3.2 projected tolerance zone, to D|E|B, D|F|B and D|G|B respectively.
Long hole Ø5.5 ±0.2, depth 35 ±1, held Ø5.5 ±0.08 in the indicated area: position Ø0.8 to D|E(M)-F(M)-G(M).
Long hole Ø5.5 ±0.2, depth 27.5 ±1, held Ø5.5 ±0.08 in the indicated area: position Ø0.8 to H|K|L.
3X Ø3.5 ±0.2 holes on the boss: position Ø0 at MMC to H|K|L, plus a 0.1 form/profile control.
Datum H: boss face, profile 1.2 to A|B|C and 0.15 to A. Line profile 0.25 to H on each line element of the boss side. Datum targets K1, K2, L1 and L2 are on the boss.
Slot 15 ±0.2 (datum J): position 1 to A|B|C, perpendicularity 0.1 to A.
Slot 5 ±0.2: symmetry 0.5 to A|J.
Inside corners: 4X R0.15 MAX at the slots and 4X R0.2 MAX at the relief.
Curved top surface: profile 1.75 to A|B|C. Straightness 0.2 per 15 on the indicated surface.
2 coplanar surfaces: profile 1 to A|B|C and 0.12 to A.

Machinability: this part cannot be completed in one 3-axis top-side setup. It has features on both faces, side cross-drilled holes, side counterbores and long horizontal holes, so multiple setups or 4/5-axis work and fixturing to datums A, B and C are required.
questions: Please supply the CAD model (note 1, model name and revision are blank). All basic geometry, including part envelope, pocket size and hole locations, is defined only by the model.
What is the material, and what is the stock size?
Is a surface finish (Ra) required? None is specified.
The thread callout 'M3x0.5-6g' is an external-thread tolerance class, but it is applied to holes. Should these be tapped M3x0.5-6H internal threads?

The job is quoted as one setup, 3-axis, top side, but the drawing needs bottom-side, side and cross-drilled features. Do you approve multiple setups or multi-axis machining, or is only the top-side scope wanted?
What edge break or deburr requirement applies to non-specified edges?
Please confirm the tolerance value and symbol for the 3X Ø3.5 ±0.2 frame row showing '0.1'. It is not clear whether this is flatness or profile, and to which datums.
